text.p: Samsonite Corp said on Tuesday it named three new executives as part of a reorganization of the company's business in the Americas.

The company said it named James Barch to vice president of hardside luggage, Robert Baird Jr to vice president of softside luggage and Gary Ervick, as president of a newly formed Samsonite distributing company in the region.
Ervick most recently was president of Samsonite's American Tourister business.
The company said the changes were part of an effort to reorganize around two product categories, hardside and softside luggage, supported by a single, strong distribution function.
